title: Travel 2025
description: At the end of the 2024-2025 Premier League season, Everton F.C. left Goodison Park, its home stadium since 1892. As a lifelong supporter of the club, I (along with my friend and my dad) decided to make the pilgrimage to the holy land and bid farewell to the storied grounds. Several months later, I traveled to Lake Tahoe with my family. The trip was marred by a less-than-serendipitous pitstop at Salt Lake City, Utah because of a faulty appendix. Everyone pulled through. All's well that ends well. Shot on Pentax K-1000 (B&W Ilford 400, Kodak 400 Ultramax, Fujifilm 400).
